comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Anyone knows how to craft the furniture for this Album?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
They can't be crafted, only selected from this item: Decorated Furniture Requisition

Unfortunately, it's only available from special server events or as a login stamp reward on JP server, so chances are they'll not be available on Maris (except possibly as cove drops or something like that).

I'd love to be proven wrong, of course. Let's hope I am. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Item%2FLoginStamp, yukimiiro.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-361.html
